# BuddyBird (버디버드)

> BuddyBird is a mobile app that helps pet parrots learn to speak while the
> owner is away. The phone by the cage plays words the owner recorded in their
> own voice, alternating learning and rest, and listens through its microphone.
> An AI model built by BuddyBird sorts the sounds the parrot makes, and a report
> lets the owner replay them later. No hardware beyond a smartphone is required.
> Free on iOS and Android.
>
> BuddyBird 는 보호자가 집을 비운 사이에도 앵무새에게 말을 가르치는 모바일 앱이다.
> 새장 옆 휴대폰이 보호자 목소리로 녹음한 단어를 학습과 휴식을 번갈아 가며 들려주고,
> 마이크로 앵무새의 소리를 듣는다. 버디버드에서 개발한 AI 모델이 앵무새가 낸 소리를
> 구분해 리포트로 보여주고, 보호자는 그 소리를 다시 들을 수 있다. 스마트폰 외의
> 장비는 필요 없고, iOS·Android 무료.

Not to be confused with **Bird Buddy**, the smart bird-feeder hardware company.
BuddyBird is an unrelated software product for pet parrot owners, made by
joynnovate. 새 모이통 하드웨어 Bird Buddy 와는 무관한 별개의 서비스다.

## How it works

1. **Record words** — the owner records the words to teach in their own voice and picks which ones to play.
2. **Learning session** — the owner picks a duration (40m, 1h 20m, 4h, a custom time, or until they end it). Learning and rest take turns; nature sounds play during rest.
3. **Listening** — while the parrot learns, the phone microphone picks up its sounds, and an AI model built by BuddyBird sorts them.
4. **Reports** — a summary appears when each session ends, and the report shows learning time by day, week and month, time per word, and the parrot's mimicked sounds to replay.

## Facts

- Category: pet care / parrot training, mobile app (iOS and Android)
- Price: free (a monthly subscription may be introduced later)
- Equipment needed: a smartphone only — no additional hardware
- Languages: Korean, English
- Maker: joynnovate
- Species support: not species-specific today; species-tailored training is planned
